features.title: Insert, edit, and atomically delete inline formulas
features.description: Deliver the existing Formula toolbar action end to end through the production Note Editor. Select and validate one concrete offline LaTex renderer before integrating it; it must be API 24 compatible, license acceptable, deterministic, and support light and dark themes. Extend the local RichText JSON with optional backward-compatible formula source and persisted inline identity fields, keeping old documents readable. Implement domain and ViewModel operations that replace a non-empty focused selection, insert at a collapsed cursor, or create and focus a paragraph when no text block is focused. Add the production formula sheet with editable source, valid rendering, localized invalid-state feedback, edit-on-tap, autosave/reload, Markdown/PDF behavior, and atomic deletion that removes the complete formula object and never leaves raw source. Keep every branch real and connected to the existing Formula action; do not land a renderer-only helper or a no-op callback.
features.user_visible_behavior: From the existing Formula action, an editor can insert a rendered inline formula into a selection, at the cursor, or in a new paragraph, reopen it for editing, and delete it as one complete object. Invalid source remains editable in the open sheet without changing the note.

features.title: Reset selected text and inherit inline marks while typing
features.description: Complete Body, Bold, Italic, Underline, Strikethrough, and inline Code through the existing formatting toolbar. Body is a direct reset action with no menu: for a non-empty selection in one focused TextBlock, split children at the selection boundaries, remove every block and inline mark from the selected range, and preserve prefix and suffix text plus their existing formatting. Each inline mark toggles only its own mark over a selected range and toggles a pending typing mark at a focused collapsed cursor. The ViewModel owns pending typing state and applies exactly those marks to subsequently typed text without changing adjacent content. When Enter creates a new line at a focused collapsed cursor in a TextBlock, the new line inherits the current block style and effective inline marks at the caret, while the existing line remains unchanged. Code must render monospace and export backticks. Keep Body and inline marks no-op for no focus or cross-block selection, preserve autosave and backward-compatible RichText JSON, and keep the 56dp toolbar visible above the IME. Include the production toolbar consumer, localized semantics, and disabled behavior needed by this slice; do not add an uncalled formatting helper.
features.user_visible_behavior: An editor can reset selected text to plain body formatting, apply or remove each inline mark without disturbing other marks, and select Bold, Italic, Underline, Strikethrough, or Code at a cursor so following typed text inherits exactly the active marks. Pressing Enter at a focused collapsed cursor preserves the current line's block style and active inline marks on the new line while leaving the existing line unchanged. The formatting toolbar stays visible above the keyboard while editing.
features.notes: Vertical-slice proof: the existing formatting toolbar exposes every requested selection, collapsed-cursor inline-mark, and formatted-new-line outcome after this slice alone. Visual screenshots are owned by the final link slice.

features.title: Keep long formula previews usable above the keyboard
features.description: Harden the production formula sheet delivered by US-1 for long source and rendered previews. Use IME insets and bounded height so the sheet expands only within the available space above the keyboard; keep the preview in a horizontally scrollable, non-wrapping, non-clipping container and keep Cancel plus the primary action reachable. When the formula sheet owns focus, it stays open above the IME and the editor formatting toolbar is not rendered behind it. Normalize every formula-sheet state to one text-only Insert or Update action with no extra plus-icon variant. Add UI semantics and state restoration for the responsive states, using the existing Formula action as the production entry point.
features.user_visible_behavior: A long formula remains horizontally scrollable inside a bounded preview, and the formula sheet remains open with its source, preview, Cancel, and Insert or Update actions usable above the keyboard. The formula dialog presents one consistent text-only insertion action.
features.notes: Vertical-slice proof: after US-1, the already-reachable Formula action exposes the responsive long-preview and IME behavior without introducing a new caller. This slice is intentionally separate from formula data semantics so its bounded-layout contract can be verified directly.

features.title: Link text to existing notes and protect the completed toolbar contract
features.description: Deliver the Link toolbar action end to end and finish the cross-feature safeguards. Extend local RichText JSON with an optional stable target note ID while preserving older documents and keeping Room and the API contract unchanged. Add a typed full-screen NoteLinkPicker route that accepts only a primitive caller note ID, excludes the current note, searches local candidates, shows title plus parent folder or localized No folder, and returns only the target ID through the saved state result. Preserve the selected label, insert a target title for no-selection and no-focused-block cases, support replacement, Remove link, and cancel/back with no unintended mutation, and render valid links as primary-color underlined tappable labels. Deleting a target note must remove the complete linked label/title from the document and exports; malformed or unresolved annotations must remain readable plain text. Complete autosave/reload, Markdown/PDF, accessibility, localization, privacy diagnostics, and read-only disabled/inert behavior for all eight controls. This final UI slice owns all visual-flow verification and must use in-test captures only.
features.user_visible_behavior: An editor can search for another note, see its folder context, create a retained-label or target-title link, replace or remove it, and tap a valid primary-color underlined link to open the target. Deleted targets remove the whole linked label, unresolved annotations remain readable plain text, and read-only notes expose all formatting controls as visible disabled controls.
